nodes.name: SkillServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements SkillService: retrieves a student's skills, searches the skill catalog, imports new skills, and compares student skills against career requirements to find gaps.

nodes.name: SkillServiceImpl
nodes.summary: SkillService implementation handling skill listing, search, import, and comparison against career requirements via SkillRepository and StudentSkillRepository.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements StudentDashboardService: aggregates roadmap progress, skill gaps, mentor feedback, AI chat history, market demand trends, and personalized recommendations for the student dashboard.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardServiceImpl
nodes.summary: StudentDashboardService implementation pulling data from many repositories (progress, feedback, chat, skill trend) and mapping it via StudentDashboardMapper for the dashboard UI.

nodes.name: StudentServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements StudentService: sets up student profiles, updates target career, compares skills against requirements, and handles transcript upload/ingestion.

nodes.name: StudentServiceImpl
nodes.summary: StudentService implementation managing student profile setup, career target updates, skill gap comparison, and transcript upload via DocumentIngestionService and SupabaseStorageService.
